links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of AI-generated versus original pathology reports; patient and urologist ratings
links.effect: AI biopsy and surgical reports had higher Flesch Reading Ease Scores (49 ± 5; 50 ± 3) than originals (31 ± 15, p < 0.001; 41 ± 17, p = 0.02). 88% of patients found AI biopsy reports helpful for understanding diagnosis.
links.quote: The AI-generated biopsy and surgical pathology reports had higher mean Flesch Reading Ease Scores (49 ± 5; 50 ± 3) compared to the original reports (31 ± 15, p < 0.001; 41 ± 17, p = 0.02, respectively).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5 to simplify prostate pathology reports, assessed by urologists and patients via readability metrics and survey feedback, but does not test a specific operational deployment safeguard or practice.
